title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: perils covered, temperature and delay conditions, and exclusions
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line decides whether a loss is one the product pays, and sets the exclusions that apply under every tier. It governs both the approval of a settlement and the rejection of a claim.

## Policy clause

1. A claim is paid only for a kind of loss the product pays; any other kind is rejected with the reason not covered by tier.
2. Temperature damage is covered only for a container whose reefer service tier rank, as ranked in the reefer charter, is at least the product's lowest rank for temperature damage. The reefer service is the one recorded on the booking for that container.
3. Where the product needs a logged temperature excursion, the reefer service must also have logged an excursion of at least the product's minimum continuous minutes on that container. The figure compared is the longest excursion logged on the reefer service for that container over the life of the service. Without such an excursion the claim is rejected with the reason no logged excursion.
4. Delay loss, covered only by AHL CargoCare Total, is paid only when the booking was rolled by the carrier at least the product's required number of times. The count covers the roll records on the cover's booking over its life that name the carrier as the initiator.
5. A claim on goods whose dangerous-goods acceptance carries a misdeclaration penalty is rejected with the reason misdeclared cargo under every product, because the goods were not those accepted.
6. Loss caused by the claimant's own insufficient packing or by inherent vice is an excluded peril under every product. Its finding rests on the survey report recorded by the claims department, never on the claimant's statement alone.
7. Settlement may be approved only while the claim's cover is in the open-claim state and the claim's documents are complete.
8. Each claim is decided once.

## Decision table

| Finding | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Kind of loss not paid by the product | Rejected: not covered by tier |
| Temperature damage, reefer service rank below the product's lowest rank | Not covered |
| Logged excursion needed, longest logged excursion shorter than the minimum | Rejected: no logged excursion |
| Dangerous-goods acceptance carries a misdeclaration penalty | Rejected: misdeclared cargo |
| Survey report records insufficient packing or inherent vice | Excluded peril |

## Hypothetical cases (hypothetical minimum of 200 minutes)

- The longest excursion logged on the container is 150 minutes: shorter than 200, so a temperature claim is rejected for no logged excursion.
- The longest excursion logged is exactly 200 minutes: at least the minimum, so this condition is met.
- The claimant states the packing was sound, but the survey report recorded by the claims department finds insufficient packing: the finding rests on the survey report, so the loss is an excluded peril.

## Points of judgement

**Delay loss on AHL CargoCare Plus?** Delay loss is covered only by AHL CargoCare Total.
